definitions.explanation: A literary and historical term for suicide, strongly associated with samurai and historical narratives. Often refers to ritual suicide or suicide to preserve honor, though it can also be used for non-ritual suicide in literary contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自害|じがい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He took his own life before the castle fell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{悟|さと}った→悟る：12601_satoru⟧⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自害|じがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: The warlord, realizing defeat was inevitable, chose to take his own life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{追|お}い{詰|つ}められた→追い詰める：14311_oitsumeru⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自害|じがい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しばしば→しばしば：02365_shibashiba⟧⟦{描|えが}かれる→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: In historical novels, scenes of cornered samurai taking their own lives are frequently depicted.

notes:
USAGE: {自害|じがい} is primarily found in historical writing, period dramas, and literary contexts. In modern everyday Japanese, ⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧ is the standard term for suicide.

The word carries connotations of the samurai code of honor and is often used when describing warriors who chose death over capture or disgrace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自害|じがい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take one's own life
- {自害|じがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧: to carry out suicide
- {自害|じがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose suicide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自害|じがい}: suicide (historical/literary, often honorable)
- ⟦{切腹|せっぷく}→切腹：11775_seppuku⟧: ritual disembowelment (specific method)
- ⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧: suicide (modern, standard term)
- ⟦{自死|じし}→自死：15360_jishi⟧: suicide (euphemistic, compassionate framing)
